page.layout: One printed page, single column of text, dedication opening with a decorative band and title block; no margin notes. Signature "a 2" at the foot left.

main_text.l: inter spinas sponsa est, inter spinas rosa
Ecclesia est: spinis septa undiq;, sive defendatur his
undiq;, sive petatur iis undiq;. Non caret
ea tutela & defensione suâ, nec poterit absq;
dolore impune quisquam tangere, si discerpere
& devastare velit eam. Quod Saul audiebat mi-
persequeris, durum est tibi contra stimulum calcitrare: Idem audiunt hodie quoq; hostes Ecclesiae omnes

page.notes: Decorative woodcut band at the top is not transcribed as text. The title block is set in mixed roman and italic type with black letter-like swash forms; "Hassiae" reads as printed "Hassiæ". Some words in the body are partly obscured by show-through and stains (e.g. "tangere", "calcitrare" uncertain). Final line "omnes" is the catchword, which also appears as the last word of the text; treated as catchword only.
